blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Facing Alex Eala on the tour also means playing in front of a frenetic and hostile crowd. Russian Tatiana Prozorova is unfazed. In fact, she sees herself thriving in such environment. “Well, yes [I’m expecting a big crowd], but I also love to play in front of a big crowd,” she said.
